kind: simulated charge spectrum (Geant4), not a measurement
use: frontend_response.py hit-efficiency --signal-model table --spectrum <this csv>: a low-side tail wider than Landau, for 300 um of silicon crossed at normal incidence by 10 GeV mu-; scale with --signal-fraction for charge sharing
